name: Yuhas Plumbing & Heating
what_they_do: Family-owned plumbing, heating and cooling contractor at 33 Jackson St, 35+ years in business: leak detection, hydro jetting, water heaters, sump pumps, boilers/furnaces, HVAC install and maintenance, with emergency service at extra cost. Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer serving homeowners and local businesses across Middlesex/Monmouth County towns.
customers: Homeowners and small commercial clients in South River and surrounding towns (Monroe, East Brunswick, Milltown, Old Bridge, Sayreville and more listed on site)

size_signals.signal: 35+ years, family-owned, NJ plumbing lic# 7275 and HVAC lic# 147600, financing available
Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer / Certified Ductless Pro marketing assets
Google listing shows 28 reviews but the profile is unclaimed and has no hours or website

website_review.trust_signals: Licence numbers, 35+ years, Carrier dealer badge, installation photos, review screenshots, service-area list
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright '© 2025'; testimonials are baked into images rather than text; /contact returns a Squarespace 404 page
website_review.search_basics: Title/description name plumbing and South River; but it is a one-page site (Services/Reviews/Contact are anchors), h1 is 'No job is too small', and there are no per-service pages or hours
top_issues: Google Business Profile is unclaimed with no hours and no website link
One-page site with anchor nav - no service or town landing pages
No contact/quote form at all; a stray /contact URL 404s

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 1: unclaimed GBP, missing hours and website, 4.2 rating. Answerable 2: services, licence numbers and service towns are readable text and LocalBusiness JSON-LD is present, but no hours, no prices, reviews locked in images. Bookable 1: no form or booking; email address and phone only.

operations_signals.signal: Every enquiry is a phone call or an email to a Gmail address (published as the contact method)
Emergency service offered 'at an additional cost' with a separate (908) emergency number - after-hours calls routed ad hoc
Google reviews at 4.2 with only 28 collected over 35 years - no systematic review capture

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (hours, services, photos, website link) and add a review-request loop
top_opportunities.evidence: Google shows 'Claim this business', 'Add hours', 'Add website'; 28 reviews / 4.2

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an online quote/booking form (job type, urgency, preferred window) and per-service pages
top_opportunities.evidence: No form on site; single page with anchor nav; /contact 404s

top_opportunities.opportunity: After-hours AI phone/chat agent that triages emergencies and books routine work, so calls are not lost
top_opportunities.evidence: Emergency line + Gmail-only intake; no scheduling tooling

scores.reasons: Gap: unclaimed GBP, no hours, no form, single page. Pay: 35-year Carrier dealer with install and emergency revenue. Ease: claiming GBP and adding hours is a day's work. Evidence: GBP unclaimed state and site DOM both checked.
